semantic.justification: Task199 adds the default-mode shared scalar arithmetic token-to-RPN subset over the existing FormulaTokenArray. Native recursive precedence, original token identities, prefix-plus elision, whitespace skipping, first-error virtual boundary, expression/token recursion limits, forced recalc retention and subtotal-return meaning are preserved for supported tokens. The base error hook remains the actual native empty operation. Unsupported opcode families, existing array-context tokens and implicit-intersection/matrix modes reject explicitly before RPN mutation. No text scanner, function/reference-operator grammar, formula-cell evaluation/recalc, ODS, UI, full compiler constructor/services, or broad parity is claimed. Existing token-array limit bounds emitted scalar RPN; native overflow paths requiring expansions are outside this subset. Scope reduction is explicit and broad flags remain unverified. Task200 keeps the original mutable protected array pointer so ScCompiler::CompileString can bind its actual newly returned token owner. No new parsing algorithm or broad shared compiler parity is claimed. Task202 serializes actual source-order scalar ODFF tokens through shared FormulaCompiler and ScCompiler reference convention into ScFormulaCell.GetFormula with explicit grammar. It preserves forced equals, source whitespace/quotes, native numeric presentation and relative/absolute A1 references at the actual cell position. It neither evaluates formulas nor stores an alternate text model. The shared native base reference hook remains empty; Calc overrides it. JS strings replace buffer fragments; actual OUString assignment preserves output ownership. Other grammars/localized symbol services,functions/names/external/range/matrix/table references and missing-argument rewrite services remain unsupported. Compiler string token output does not imply string-expression evaluation. Localized empty-code errors reject explicitly. ODS filters and UI are not implemented by this task; no broad native parity is certified. Task N4JV15 adds the native OOO A1 convention for the existing arithmetic/local-reference subset (GRAM_NATIVE, GRAM_ENGLISH and GRAM_ODFF_A1), sharing actual source/RPN tokens, relative/absolute flags and document listeners with ODFF. Native and ODFF output round-trip the same formula owner without evaluation. Scalar operator spellings in this subset coincide across the represented languages; localized numeric input, function names and separators remain unsupported. Native deleted/out-of-range column and row fragments follow ConventionOOO_A1. No UI formula rewrite, second model or broad compiler parity claim. Block72 ports ordinary SUM/SUMSQ/PRODUCT/AVERAGE variable arguments,English/ODFF symbols,quoted string/missing tokens and byte arity255 through the actual shared compiler and Calc token/document/interpreter owners. Numeric and single-reference parameters use original portable non-SSE2 KahanSum operations;native argument order,empty/text/error behavior and final average/product defaults are preserved. Real input/history/dependency/ODS/primary storage paths consume these owners. Range/area broadcasts and array accumulation are planned in dependent73;other functions,localized conversion,external/named/matrix references and nondefault subtotal/format services remain unsupported. This bounded slice does not certify broad native parity. Block73 extends the prior bounded slices with native local/ODFF rectangular and whole-axis double references,shared RangeLine compilation,default scalar intersection,range aggregate execution over actual typed stores,and ordinary area-slot dependency ownership. Native logarithmic slot geometry,shared identity,bulk/deferred erasure,reference-update chaining,sheet shifts and semantic destruction are consumed without individual-cell listener expansion. ScValueIterator and RangeColumnSpanSet use actual document/column stores;portable array accumulation retains original four-stream Kahan order. Typed double out-references preserve encoded NaN payload storage. Earlier exclusions of these specific services are superseded here. Group/3D/external/named-reference expressions,matrix evaluation,nondefault subtotal/text-zero and number-format services remain unsupported;broader parity remains unverified. CALC250-252 record retained upstream edge behavior and limits on numerical evidence.
